Bug_Title: Overrides should match their parent class methods in synchronization
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by having the overridden method 'foo' in the 'Child' class not being synchronized, while the method in the 'Parent' class is synchronized. This leads to improper synchronization as callers rely on the thread-safety promised by the parent class.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the'showBug' method of the 'SynchronizationBugExample' class, which triggers the bug by creating multiple threads that call the unsynchronized overridden 'foo' method of the 'Child' class, leading to improper synchronization.
